heroWhy.h: A three-product shelf beside a panel naming the collection and its starting price.
heroWhy.j: Three large category tiles with item counts, in place of a hero image.
heroWhy.k: A flat accent band with a headline, subheadline and one call to action.
heroWhy.l: A full-bleed photo with a floating card for one product in the bottom-left corner.
heroWhy.m: No image — a two-line tagline strip above the first collection's heading.

listingWhy.none: No listing — the page ends after the hero and tiles.

listingWhy.p2: All products, six columns, a dense grid of twelve, title and price only.
listingWhy.p3: A row list with image, title, a spec line and price for each product.
listingWhy.p4: A three-column masonry wall of nine products, image, title and price.
listingWhy.p5: One large lead product beside four smaller ones, editorial layout.
